body.p: To configure the options for the Markdown editor, and go to Editor Edit modes Markdown .

The following option is available:
Enable comments If selected (default), you can add comments to content in Markdown documents, the comments are presented as highlights over the commented content, they are displayed in the Preview pane, and they are saved in the document as HTML comments. If deselected, no comments can be added, the HTML comments that are already in a document are displayed in the editor as regular content, and comments are not displayed in the Preview pane.
